meta.description: Arena Reborn - a free private server for DofusArena 2.70, the tactical PvP game from the Dofus universe. Create an account and play.
lang.label: Language
footer.tagline: A preservation server for DofusArena 2.70, run by fans, for fans.
footer.disclaimer: An unofficial, non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Ankama. DofusArena and Dofus are the property of Ankama — all rights reserved.
impersonate.viewing: You are viewing this site as
index.lede: The legendary tactical PvP game from the Dofus universe, brought back and kept alive. Build a team, learn the ground, and win on skill alone — there is nothing to farm and nothing to grind.
index.ready.member: Download the game, sign in, and you are ready to play.
index.ready.guest: Create an account, download the game, and you are ready to play.
index.why.title: What makes Arena special
index.why.lede: The tactical depth that made DofusArena worth preserving.
index.f1.title: Pure strategy
index.f1.body: Every decision counts. No farming, no levelling, no gear treadmill — you and your opponent start on equal terms and the better tactician wins.
index.f2.title: Ranked ladder
index.f2.body: Face opponents near your own rating and climb. Every result moves you, and the leaderboard is public.
index.f3.title: Your own team
index.f3.body: Recruit fighters, equip them, and find the synergies nobody else has spotted. Teams are yours to build and rebuild at will.
index.f4.title: The real thing
index.f4.body: This runs the original 2012 client against a server rebuilt from scratch to match it exactly — not a remake, but the game as it actually was.
index.get.title: Ready to join the battle?
index.get.lede: Create an account for free, download the game, and you are in.

delete.what.body: Your account, your coach, all of your fighters, cards, teams, friend and ignore lists, mail, guild membership and match record are permanently removed from the database. Nothing is archived, and nothing can be restored afterwards.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.lede: Who runs this, what it is, and how to reach us if you hold rights in anything you see here.
legal.affiliation.title: Not affiliated with Ankama
legal.affiliation.body: This is an independent, fan-run project. It is not affiliated with, authorised by, endorsed by or connected to Ankama Games in any way. DofusArena, Dofus, and all related names, logos, characters and artwork are trademarks or copyrighted works of Ankama Games, referred to here only to describe what this server is compatible with.
legal.what.title: What this project is
legal.what.body: DofusArena 2 was discontinued by its publisher and its official servers were shut down. This project preserves it: an independently written game server, built from scratch by studying how the original client communicates, so the game can still be played. The server software is our own original work and is published under the MIT licence.
legal.client.title: About the game client
legal.client.body: The DofusArena 2.70 client — the game program itself, with its artwork, audio and bundled runtime — is Ankama's copyrighted work, and we claim no rights in it whatsoever. We make it available for download, pre-configured so it connects to this server without manual setup. That includes a small modification to the client so its in-game links point here; like the client itself, that modification remains subject to Ankama's rights and we assert no ownership over it. It is offered for one reason only — so that a discontinued game stays playable — no money is taken for it, and it will be removed immediately at Ankama's request.
legal.noncommercial.title: No money is involved
legal.noncommercial.body: This service is free. We do not sell anything, accept donations, run advertising, or offer any paid advantage. There is nothing to buy here and no revenue of any kind — hosting is paid for privately by the operator.
legal.takedown.title: Rights holders
legal.takedown.body: If you hold rights in material used here and want it removed, you do not need to involve a lawyer. Write to the address below describing the material, and it will be removed promptly. We would much rather hear from you directly.
legal.takedown.nocontact: This server's operator has not published a contact address. If you are a rights holder, please contact the operator of this site directly.
legal.trademarks: All trademarks are the property of their respective owners. Java and the runtime bundled with the original client are the property of Oracle Corporation.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lede: What this server stores about you, why it stores it, and how to get rid of it.
privacy.controller.title: Who is responsible
privacy.controller.body: The data controller is the person or group operating this server. They decide what is stored and are the ones to contact about it, at the address at the bottom of this page.
privacy.collect.title: What we store
privacy.collect.body: As little as the game needs in order to work:
privacy.collect.account: Your account name, and a bcrypt hash of your password. The password itself is never stored. We do not ask for an email address or your real name.
privacy.collect.game: Your in-game data: your coach, fighters, cards, teams, friend and ignore lists, mail, guild membership and match record.
privacy.collect.ip: Your IP address, held briefly in memory to rate-limit sign-ups and sign-in attempts. It is not written to the database and is not used to build a profile.
privacy.collect.bug: If you send a bug report from inside the game, the text you wrote and the screenshot the client attached to it.
privacy.never.title: What we do not do
privacy.never.body: No advertising, no analytics, no tracking pixels, no third-party scripts and no external fonts — every page is served entirely from this server. Your data is never sold, rented or shared with anyone.
privacy.basis.title: Our legal basis
privacy.basis.body: Account and game data are processed to provide the service you asked for when you registered. IP-based rate limiting rests on our legitimate interest in keeping the server available and resistant to abuse.
privacy.retention.title: How long we keep it
privacy.retention.body: Your account and game data are kept until you delete your account, which erases them. Rate-limiting records live in memory only and expire within the hour. Bug reports are kept until an operator resolves and removes them.
privacy.cookies.title: Cookies
privacy.cookies.body: Three cookies, all strictly necessary and all first-party: a signed session cookie once you sign in, a CSRF token protecting forms against cross-site submission, and one remembering your chosen language. No tracking or advertising cookies are set, which is why this site has no cookie banner.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.access: See everything we hold about you — your account page already lists all of it, in full, at any time.
privacy.rights.erase: Delete it. The delete button on your account page erases your account and every record attached to it, immediately and permanently.
privacy.rights.complain: Complain to your national data-protection authority if you believe your data has been mishandled.
privacy.contact.title: Contact
privacy.contact.none: This server's operator has not published a contact address. Please contact the operator of this site directly to exercise your rights.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lede: The short version: it is free, be decent, and nothing is guaranteed.
terms.service.title: A free, volunteer service
terms.service.body: This server is run by volunteers at their own expense. It costs nothing to use and nothing is for sale. It may be slow, may lose data, may change, and may be shut down at any time without notice.
terms.account.title: Your account
terms.account.body: One account is for one person. Keep your password to yourself — you are responsible for what happens under your account. Do not impersonate other players or staff.
terms.conduct.title: Conduct
terms.conduct.body: No cheating, no exploiting bugs, and no modified clients or automation used to gain an advantage. No harassment, hate speech or threats. Do not use account names, coach names or chat to post anything unlawful. Report bugs instead of abusing them.
terms.client.title: The game client
terms.client.body: Playing requires the DofusArena 2.70 client, which we provide as a pre-configured download. It remains Ankama's property and is not ours to license: your use of it is subject to Ankama's own terms, and we will withdraw it at any time at their request.
terms.nowarranty.title: No warranty
terms.nowarranty.body: The service is provided as is, with no warranty of any kind. Your account, your characters and your progress carry no real-world value and can be lost. To the fullest extent the law allows, the operator accepts no liability for any loss arising from use of this service.
terms.termination.title: Suspension
terms.termination.body: We may suspend or delete any account that breaks these terms or puts the server or its players at risk, at our discretion and without notice. You can delete your own account at any time from your account page.
terms.changes: These terms may change. Continuing to use the server after a change means you accept the new version.
